High-Quality Upscale

Smart Auto analyses every image — its resolution, sharpness and design type (logo / flat graphic vs photo) — and automatically picks the ideal enlargement factor (up to 4×) with smooth multi-step resampling. Ideal before tracing or for printing.

Drop images here to upscale

or use the button below

JPG · PNG · WebP — Smart Auto decides the factor per image (up to 4×)

#FileStatusDownload
Upscaling enlarges pixels with smart smoothing — it can't invent detail that isn't there. For best results start from the highest resolution image you have.

Upscale Settings

Smart Auto: each file is scanned when added — small images get up to 4×, medium ones 2–3×, and images that are already large pass through untouched (1×). Flat graphics (logos, icons, line art) get a stronger boost than photos because their edges scale cleanly. The chosen factor is shown on every row.

Background Remover

Delete the background from any JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF or SVG — including AI-generated art — with clean, noise-free, feathered edges and zero color halos. Output is a transparent PNG or WebP, processed 100% on your device.

JPG · PNG · WebP · BMP · GIF · SVG · AI-generated art  |  best results on plain or studio backgrounds

#FileStatusDownload
Smart tips: background left behind? Raise Tolerance. Subject getting eaten? Lower it. Noise cleanup deletes stray specks and dirt, Edge smoothness adds a soft feather, and Halo remover neutralizes color fringing — so the cutout stays perfectly clean. Works best when the subject contrasts with its backdrop.

Metadata settings

Your keys are used directly from the browser — images are never sent anywhere except as an optional description prompt derived from the file name and colours. Add several keys in API Keys and the app automatically retries with the next one when a key is out of quota.
